sentences: Following the player’s confession, the Swiss Football Federation said in a statement that Xhaka will not participate in the upcoming men’s national team training camp.
Summary Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka admitted to obtaining vaccination certificates without being vaccinated due to personal uncertainty and distrust towards the Covid-19 vaccine.
Xhaka expressed regret and vowed to cooperate with authorities, leading to his exclusion from the national team's upcoming training camp.

First Published: Monday, 21 Sep 2026 7:09 PM MYT × Subscribe to Newsletter Subscribe BERLIN, Sept 21 — Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka admitted that he obtained coronavirus vaccination certificates without actually being vaccinated, reported German Press Agency (dpa).
“At the time, I was personally very uncertain about the Covid-19 vaccine and had serious reservations,” he wrote on Instagram on Monday.
“In this state of emotional turmoil, I obtained a vaccination certificate instead of clarifying my unanswered questions through the proper channels,” Xhaka wrote.
I take responsibility for this decision, am committed to addressing the facts of the matter, and will cooperate fully with the relevant authorities,” Xhaka said.
Xhaka contracted coronavirus in 2021 and early 2022, the Blick newspaper said.
